scripts.build: pnpm --filter site-boosts build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/protocol build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/credentials build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/site-mapper build && pnpm --filter browser-crawl build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/tools build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/cdp build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/engine build && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/bridge && pnpm --filter @browserkit/extension build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @browserkit/protocol build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/credentials build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/site-mapper build && pnpm --filter browser-crawl build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/tools build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/cdp build && pnpm --filter @browserkit/engine build && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/extension --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/bridge --noEmit && pnpm --filter site-boosts typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter site-boosts lint && pnpm --filter @browserkit/site-mapper lint && pnpm --filter browser-crawl lint && node scripts/check-source-limits.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm test:engine && pnpm test:site-mapper && pnpm test:crawl && pnpm test:workflows && pnpm test:boosts && node scripts/run-tests.mjs "test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm agent-text:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
